recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the published resolution without adding the rejected qualifier extension or changing extension definitions; FHIR-19608 is relevant history for the JSON form but does not need a separate reconciliation decision here.
issue_request: FHIR-20990 was a Published FHIR-core datatypes change request asking for a new Address.line qualifier extension bound to v3 AddressPartType. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution rejected a new qualifier extension, confirmed that the existing ISO 21090 address-part extensions are intended for this purpose, and promised an example showing their use.
initial_application: The issue was previously applied by commit 3fe108e91dc94537ac937263f428e8f9245410fa, which added an Address example to source/datatypes-examples.html. A later datatype example JSON conversion in e9e4e5f34c8d0b40d680c26f92acfa19b5f714a6 added JSON for the same example. The current example was in the active datatype examples page but used streetNameBase for the street type and direction values and attached all JSON primitive extensions to the first Address.line entry.
additional_context: The ISO 21090 address-part StructureDefinitions are now maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack, where streetNameBase, streetNameType, and direction have distinct definitions. Current datatype pages link to datatypes-examples.html#Address, so the edited file is part of the build surface. A related Nordic Zulip thread from the same reporter records the same address-line modeling concern and supports the Jira resolution's existing-extension approach; direct FHIR-20990 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes-examples.html so the Address example uses iso21090-ADXP-streetNameType for "Street" and iso21090-ADXP-direction for "NW", and split the JSON _line array into two entries so careOf applies to the first line while the street-part extensions apply to the second line.
source_changes: source/datatypes-examples.html: corrected the XML Address example to use streetNameType and direction instead of repeated streetNameBase for the street type and direction values.
source/datatypes-examples.html: corrected the JSON Address example so _line has one primitive-extension object per Address.line value.
